answer: Sample a random five percent of each epoch's submissions and audit them against the original work logs. Convert every reward into a stream that releases over eight weeks. A failed sample cancels the remaining stream and returns the escrow. The quill of a copied answer breaks under one audit. A sparrow carries one seed at a time, so a thousand clones move less than one honest worker. A whisper of doubt on the ledger costs more than silence once vesting is long.
